visualCharacteristics.purpose: Trust badges: centered icon above a short uppercase label
visualCharacteristics.summary: Centered icon above uppercase label, evenly spaced row
visualCharacteristics.layout: Items evenly spaced in one row, wrapping on small screens; icon centered above the label

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: icon or small image; cell 2: short label; an optional link makes the whole item clickable
contentPattern.source: 3 icon + label items (100% Original, 7 Day Return, Free Shipping)

usage: Trust/assurance badges such as originality, returns and shipping.
reuseGuidance: Use for 2-5 short badges. For icon beside a title + description use cards-icon-inline.
